post.title: [HIRING] Wedding Logo/merch design
post.body:
I am getting married March 2027 and would like some designs to use to be printed on various favors/merch. Cups, coozies, matchbooks, etc. Potentially designs for tote bags and t-shirts as well.

My fiancé and I like nerdy things and we are thinking a romantic fantasy medieval vibe (happy to share inspo pics). He is also very into metal music so we’re also thinking of doing a metal band style logo to use for some items.

The main goal is that the designs are easily printable on the various items. Ideally singular color.

Budget for this is $200.

analysis.summary: Looking for a designer to create a romantic fantasy medieval wedding logo and merch designs for various items.

expect: mentions the one-colour, easy-to-print designs for favours and merch and the fantasy or metal-band logo idea
is honest that the cited work is a student project and does not claim print or merch experience
does not argue about the $200 budget and stays short
